description:
What are some film quotes that have stuck with Adam Savage from a moral/philosophical perspective, such as: "Nothing is right or wrong; it's either the law or it's not the law"? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers this question from Tested member Ziz62266, whom we thank for their support! What are some of your favorite philosophical movie lines, and what films are they from?
